text: (b) 6 points Let A be an array of n elements, indexed from 1 to n, which represent the post-order traversal of a BST. Your job is to write a procedure that re-creates the tree from this input. You must pro- vide the pseudo-code for a recursive algorithm, called RecreateBST(A s.f) which takes as input the array A and the indices that define the array elements to be used. The initial call will be to RecreateBST(A, 1,n). *You may use z = New Tree node() when you want to create a new node object
